# `tlgr passport`

5 operations. Every one takes the global flags (`--json`, `--plain`, `-a/--account`, `--results-only`, `--select`, `--dry-run`, `--yes`, `--no-input`, `--flood-wait-max`, `-v`) anywhere on the line.

### `passport authorize`

Authorize a service with Telegram Passport (not supported: see the help).

Registered so the command exists and explains itself, and refused with NOT_SUPPORTED. Sharing identity documents through a crypto stack tlgr does not implement is worse than not offering it.

```
tlgr passport authorize <BOT> [OPTIONS]
```

**mutating · destructive (needs `--yes` off a TTY) · returns `PassportForm`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `BOT` | chat | yes | The service's bot. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--password` | text |  | The 2FA cloud password. |
| `--public-key` | path |  | The service's RSA key (PEM). |
| `--scope` | json |  | Scope JSON from the service. |
| `--values` | json |  | Which stored value satisfies each type. |

```console
$ tlgr passport authorize @examplebot --json
```

<details><summary>Catalog coverage (0 full, 1 partial)</summary>

Partial: `passport.authorization`

The request is readable (`passport form get`); acceptance needs the Passport secure-value crypto and raises NOT_SUPPORTED.

</details>

### `passport list`

List the Telegram Passport documents stored on my account.

Metadata only. The values are encrypted under a secret derived from the cloud password, and tlgr does not implement that KDF — which is why this feature is catalogued as partial rather than claimed.

```
tlgr passport list [OPTIONS]
```

**paginated (`LOCAL` cursor) · returns `Page[PassportValue]`**

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--decrypt` | flag |  | Attempt to decrypt the values (needs the crypto stack). |
| `--type` | text |  | Restrict to these document types (repeatable). |

Pagination is transport-level: `--limit/-n`, `--cursor TOKEN`, `--all` (walked inside the daemon, paced by the account's own rate limiter).

```console
$ tlgr passport list --json
```

<details><summary>Catalog coverage (1 full, 0 partial)</summary>

Full: `passport.list`

</details>

### `passport verify`

Verify an extra phone number or email.

```

```

**mutating · returns `PassportVerification`**

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--code` | text |  | Code that arrived; omit to request one. |

| `--phone` | text |  | Phone number to verify. |
